Bai Qingning's face instantly flashed through Zhao Hongzhu's mind.



After returning to the Qin residence, she had never formally visited Bai Qingning. The two of them tacitly avoided each other's presence, as if as long as they hadn't met face to face, they could maintain the surface calm.



But while she had been secretly laying lines and plotting for benefits, Bai Qingning had already secretly spread a large net, waiting for her to enter the cage.



She didn't know how Bai Qingning had learned of her plan or how she had made her move. She only knew that this time, she had lost too badly. Bai Qingning had directly cut off all her paths.



All the plans that had been entrenched in her mind were completely disrupted. She had never been so panicked. Her only driftwood had been lost. After today, how could she establish herself in the Qin family? With what state of mind would Qin Shanyue face her?



Just at this moment, footsteps sounded outside the door, followed by Qin Shanyue's hoarse voice from outside.



"Hongzhu."



When Zhao Hongzhu raised her eyes, she saw Qin Shanyue standing at the doorway with bloodshot eyes. He was someone who could wade through mountains of corpses and seas of blood without blinking, yet at this moment he didn't dare step across that small threshold. He only stood far away, gazing at the woman on the bed.



She was the beautiful dream of his youth, the treasure he had buried in the long river of time, the moonlight he didn't dare touch even in midnight dreams. And now, all the beauty had been ground away completely. The pearl who had once crowned the capital with her beauty had lost her luster, curled up on the bed, as if tottering and about to shatter at any moment.



Qin Shanyue suddenly didn't dare to ask.



He didn't dare touch this pearl again. He was afraid Zhao Hongzhu would just shatter like this.



But just as Qin Shanyue's heart was retreating and he wanted to leave, Zhao Hongzhu suddenly threw herself off the bed as if crazed. Her entire person directly fell to the ground with a thud, her delicate skin heavily hitting the floor. But she herself seemed not to notice, only raising her head to look at Qin Shanyue.



What kind of face was that? Bright eyes filled with tears swaying in the wind, as if about to dissipate between heaven and earth at any moment, pitiful and heart-wrenching. By the time Qin Shanyue reacted, he had already rushed over, half-kneeling on the ground, holding Zhao Hongzhu in his arms.



"I was harmed by someone, Shanyue. I was harmed by someone." Zhao Hongzhu held onto Qin Shanyue, tears falling like broken pearl strings. Her voice trembled as she cried painfully: "A maid passed me a message saying to find you in that side room. As soon as I entered, I was knocked unconscious. When I woke up, it was like this. Shanyue, I was harmed by someone."



When Zhao Hongzhu said this, the trusted maid kneeling beside her instantly reacted. She wiped away her tears, crawled on her knees to Qin Shanyue, and kowtowed, saying: "This servant was ordered at the time and stood guard outside. Who would have thought the side room would suddenly catch fire, and then that Miss Qian brought a large group of people. Although this servant is stupid, I also know there must be something fishy in all this. I beseech the General to investigate clearly, find justice for my young miss, and restore my young miss's innocence."



When Qin Shanyue heard these words, all his original doubts about Zhao Hongzhu vanished into thin air. He knew it—his Hongzhu was the best girl in the whole world. She absolutely could not possibly have drugged Bai Yunhe with aphrodisiac incense to achieve her goals. But what followed was anger. Who had harmed Zhao Hongzhu?



Qin Shanyue had commanded the army for years. Military orders were like mountains. All his dealings were straightforward confrontations with clear rules where no one dared cross the line even one step. He rarely dealt with the dark secrets of household courtyards, and because of this matter his mind was in chaos. For a moment he had no clue, only tightly holding Zhao Hongzhu in his arms.



Zhao Hongzhu looked once again at her maid.



Her maid was called Lancao. They had grown up together since childhood. The two talked about everything. All the thoughts that couldn't be told to outsiders could be told to each other. Later, during the three years in the northern desert, the two had lived and died together. With just one look from Zhao Hongzhu, Lancao understood what Zhao Hongzhu wanted to do.



Now that things had already become like this, regardless of what had actually happened, the result could no longer be changed. Therefore, she and her mistress could only try their best to twist the result in the best direction.



So Lancao directly lunged forward. While Qin Shanyue was still thinking about who had made a move against Zhao Hongzhu, Lancao shouted loudly: "General! This servant remembers who the maid was who came to call Miss to the side room today! It was a maid from Madam's side!"



Qin Shanyue's entire body trembled.

chapters.title: Eleven
chapters.content:
In that exchange of glances between Zhao Hongzhu and Lancao, the two of them solidified one conviction: they had to bring Bai Qingning down.

That Bai Yunhe already had a marriage engagement and would certainly not treat Zhao Hongzhu well. The only person they could rely on was Qin Shanyue. So they had to find a way to stay by Qin Shanyue's side.

Before, she had wanted to keep Qin Shanyue through purity and love. Now, she could only use guilt and propriety—Zhao Hongzhu decided to drag Bai Qingning into the water. As long as she pointed all blame at Bai Qingning, Qin Shanyue would never be able to abandon her again.

Because Qin Shanyue also loved Bai Qingning.

When the woman he loved had hurt another woman he loved, he could only be forced to swallow all the bitter fruits. Given Qin Shanyue's nature, the more pitiful Zhao Hongzhu was, the more his sense of responsibility would compel him to show every manner of sympathy to Zhao Hongzhu, and he would also have friction with Bai Qingning.

This was a path of settling for second best.

"Impossible." Qin Shanyue finally spoke. His voice was hoarse, the veins on his face trembling, as he said through gritted teeth: "This is impossible. Qingning is not that kind of person."

No one knew better than Qin Shanyue what kind of girl Bai Qingning was.

Bai Qingning was a girl carefully raised by a proper wife. Although she was born of a concubine, her insight was not shallow. She was kind-hearted, quite tolerant toward maids and servants in the household who made mistakes, and her temperament was gentle and refined, fond of tending flowers and reading books, never quarreling with anyone.

How could such a Qingning possibly harm Zhao Hongzhu?

"General! If not Madam, then who? In this vast Qin residence, who could arrange things so seamlessly? And why was the man specifically the Bai family's eldest legitimate son?" Lancao knelt prostrate on the ground and began kowtowing repeatedly with loud thuds, her voice as piercing as a dying bird: "Everyone in the entire Qin residence knows our Miss has given her heart to you and would marry no one but you! Naturally Madam cannot stand our Miss being with you—she wants to ruin our Miss! With something like this happening, our Miss has lost all her purity and has no path left to live. General, Bai Qingning is trying to drive our Miss to her death!"

When Bai Qingning entered the side room leading Bai Yunhe—who had just straightened his clothing—she heard this sharp cry.

Her gaze swept over the two people huddled together on the ground, then looked toward Lancao kowtowing to the side. Before she could even open her mouth to speak, she heard Bai Yunhe behind her let out an explosive shout: "Outrageous! You lowly servants dare to make slanderous accusations against the mistress of the house!"

Earlier in the side room, after sending away the old physician, Bai Qingning had a brief discussion with Bai Yunhe. They were after all blood siblings, and Bai Yunhe had watched Bai Qingning grow up. Naturally he believed Bai Qingning. Bai Qingning only said she knew nothing at all, which made Bai Yunhe even more certain that it must have been Zhao Hongzhu who had made a move against him in order to threaten him into overturning the case.

Bai Yunhe stepped into the side room with a face full of murderous intent, the official authority he had cultivated in the Ministry of Justice bearing down directly on Qin Shanyue.

Although the gap in their official ranks was considerable, when it concerned his own interests, Bai Yunhe could not retreat even half a step. He strode in with large steps, and several words rained down directly on Qin Shanyue's face.

"The lowly servant talks utter nonsense! If Bai Qingning wanted to harm her, she could have picked any random servant. Why would she pick me? I am the Bai family's eldest legitimate son. If she had me marry a convicted criminal's daughter, what benefit could the Bai family possibly gain?"

"If General Qin believes this matter was a conspiracy between me and Qingning, then produce evidence. Otherwise, I will petition the throne to prove my innocence!"

When Bai Yunhe's voice fell, both Zhao Hongzhu and Lancao instinctively shrank back.

Qin Shanyue looked toward the doorway with reddened eyes. His gaze slid past Bai Yunhe's face and settled fixedly on Bai Qingning standing beside Bai Yunhe.

Everyone in the room was in disarray, but she alone was calm in expression, as if nothing could enter her eyes. Only after the room fell into dead silence did Bai Qingning speak.

"Does Miss Zhao mean to say she suspects I harmed you out of jealousy?" Bai Qingning asked, looking toward Zhao Hongzhu.

Zhao Hongzhu, held in Qin Shanyue's arms, was trembling all over. A look of panic and unease surfaced on her face. She shook her head and said: "Hongzhu wouldn't dare. Hongzhu is already a guilty person. Being sheltered by the Qin residence is already an enormous grace. Madam's kindness is something Hongzhu keeps close to heart, and I would not dare harbor even half a doubt."

It was nothing but polite words, yet Bai Qingning chose to take them at face value.

Bai Qingning looked toward Lancao: "Did you hear that? Even your Miss knows that entering the Qin residence is a grace bestowed upon you. You, a lowly servant, dare to jump out and slander the mistress and sow discord! In my Qin residence, a maid with such lack of manners shall first receive fifty slaps, then be dragged out for twenty strikes with a rod."

The moment Bai Qingning's words fell, she raised a hand behind her.

Two matrons stepped out from behind her and walked up to Lancao. "Slap, slap"—they began striking Lancao's face.

Lancao was hit until blood appeared beneath her nose and her ears rang. She knelt prostrate on the ground crying and calling out "Miss." Zhao Hongzhu in shock grabbed Qin Shanyue's arm crying out "Brother Qin." The entire side room was filled with Lancao's cries and wails.

Qin Shanyue could endure no more, and finally roared: "Qingning! At a time like this, why are you fixating on a maid's offense? What she said was nothing more than speculation!"

"In broad daylight, she is merely a lowly servant with no evidence whatsoever, yet she comes to slander me with empty words. The General thinks she is not at fault—rather that I am at fault? What does the General think I should do? Simply allow dirty water to be splashed on me? I am the Madam. She is a servant. General, with nothing but speculation, can a servant convict a Madam? Is it truly that I am fixating on her offense, or is it that the General's heart has long since tilted toward someone else?"

Bai Qingning's voice suddenly rose higher, louder even than Qin Shanyue's, and in that moment left Qin Shanyue completely speechless.

Qin Shanyue had never seen Bai Qingning display such sharp-edged candor.

"Since the General suspects me, then bring the Qin residence's maids here for questioning. How my brother was poisoned, how he was brought to the side room, who deceived Miss Zhao into going there, and why the side room caught fire—investigate each point one by one."

Bai Qingning stood at the doorway, seeming somewhat exhausted. She shook her sleeves and said: "As this matter concerns me, it would not be appropriate for me to be directly involved. I shall return to my room and await everyone's news. I also ask the General to investigate clearly and restore my innocence."

Having said that, Bai Qingning turned and left.

She left with such decisiveness, as if after walking away she would never look back again. Qin Shanyue's heart inexplicably trembled. He called out loudly: "Qingning!"

Bai Qingning didn't look back. She only paused in her steps, and replied in a clear, cool voice: "If you don't want people to know, then simply don't do it. General, investigate away. As for who administered the drug, who went to the side room, and who is now reaping what they sowed—that person knows clearly in their own heart."

Zhao Hongzhu's face turned suddenly pale at hearing these words.

After saying that, Bai Qingning lifted her foot and stepped over the threshold.

As she walked out the door, a gust of wind came to meet her. The deep autumn air had already turned cold, but as it lifted her skirts, it brought with it a strangely liberating feeling. She felt that she was not stepping over a threshold, but stepping out of the shackles of her past life.

All those who had harmed her and betrayed her in her past life were now imprisoned in that tiny side room. Not one of them could walk out. They would tear at each other, hurt each other, fight without end until death, and spend the rest of their lives living in hatred for one another. Whenever they heard the other's name, they would be reminded of their own humiliating history.

But she had already broken free from all restraints, and had struck back—heavily.

As she stepped out of the side room door, Bai Qingning raised her head to look at the sky.

After all this commotion, the sky had long darkened. She was just in time to see the vast expanse of evening glow. It was very beautiful.

This was her first victory.

Bai Qingning lifted her skirts and slowly walked back to her room.

In her room, only Chunri had been left behind. Seeing Bai Qingning arrive, Chunri bowed and reported to Bai Qingning on everything that had happened that day.

chapters.title: Twelve
chapters.content:
The little maid that Zhao Hongzhu had sent to drug Qin Shanyue had been obtained from the Old Madam. The Old Madam had lived so many years that she could understand intent from the faintest hint. She had surely seen through Zhao Hongzhu's scheme completely, yet the Old Madam hadn't stopped it. She had even secretly instructed those maids to help Zhao Hongzhu with her arrangements.

From what Bai Qingning knew of the Old Madam, in her past life, after what had happened between Zhao Hongzhu and Qin Shanyue, the Old Madam would put on a stance of "this was all an accident caused by Qin Shanyue's drunkenness, and Qin Shanyue must take responsibility for Zhao Hongzhu." She would act as Zhao Hongzhu's advocate. Qin Shanyue himself was already wavering, and with this push, he naturally and smoothly began taking responsibility for Zhao Hongzhu.

But in this lifetime, Bai Qingning had inserted herself sideways.

In her past life, there had been a servant in their household who frequently went to gambling dens and had racked up debts. He should have been beaten to death by debt collectors at the door three days prior. Bai Qingning had secretly hired outside ruffians, found this servant, given him a sum of money, and had him swap out the wine that had been laced with aphrodisiac incense.

The unaltered cup went to Qin Shanyue. The tampered cup went to Bai Yunhe.

Then after Bai Yunhe had gotten drunk, they helped him into the side room.

So even if that servant was eventually traced, it could never lead back to Bai Qingning.

They would only trace the maid who had drugged Qin Shanyue—and this had actually been part of Zhao Hongzhu's plan all along, to push forward a maid to serve as the culprit.

Even if both Zhao Hongzhu and Bai Qingning knew this maid wasn't the true culprit, in the end, she was the only one who could be blamed.

As for the side room catching fire, that was even simpler. Qian Biyu was the most useful pawn. Bai Qingning had also stacked dry, easily combustible firewood and a flint under the eaves. As long as Qian Biyu had even a sliver of sense, she would surely start a fire to attract people. No matter how thoroughly the Qin family investigated, they could only trace it back to Qian Biyu. It had absolutely nothing to do with Bai Qingning.

Bai Qingning sorted through all the threads of her plan in her mind, then asked: "Has the Old Madam received any news?"

"No." Chunri shook her head: "This servant followed Madam's instructions and sealed Lotus Courtyard airtight. Not a single maid slipped out. The Old Madam's matron did come to check once, asking why Lotus Courtyard was sealed. This servant only said it was Madam's orders, and the matron didn't ask further."

Bai Qingning curved the corner of her lips.

She had sealed off the news in time. The Old Madam only knew that something had happened tonight, but didn't know exactly what.

The Old Madam probably still thought that things between Zhao Hongzhu and Qin Shanyue had gone according to plan.

Bai Qingning returned to her senses and didn't bring up the matter again. Instead, she asked: "And Qiuyue?"

These past few days had been consumed by the banquet, and Bai Qingning had been locked in scheming against others the whole time. Qiuyue had also been too busy to be spared, so she hadn't been sent out.

After today passed, Bai Qingning planned to use the cover of having Qiuyue go out to "purchase supplies" to let her out, so Qiuyue could go to Gongzi Garden to check on the mute slave.

"She's still busy in the back kitchen." Chunri lowered her head and replied softly: "If Madam wishes to see Qiuyue, this servant will go find her for Madam."

"No need." Bai Qingning pinched the bridge of her nose and shook her head: "Just let Qiuyue stay in the back kitchen."

Qiuyue was not capable of handling affairs—her thoughts were plain and her courage small. In matters like these, Bai Qingning didn't plan to involve her. In her past life she hadn't managed to protect Qiuyue. In this life, she was determined to give Qiuyue a good ending.

Bai Qingning thought about the matters in the rear courtyard, calculated the timing, and glanced up at the full moon in the sky.

She wondered what the mute slave was doing now.

It would be soon.

Her plan would succeed very soon.

——

The moon had risen high in the sky. Gongzi Garden was at its liveliest hour.

The sounds of strings and woodwinds floated up, gauze curtains swayed in the breeze, and men wearing nothing but undergarments danced on the stage with folding fans to the music. Many women led their kept companions into private rooms. The rooms were all very close together, and the wooden walls blocked out nothing at all—the indecent sounds from next door burrowed straight into one's ears.

The companions of Gongzi Garden all had two parts skill, especially in bed. As long as they lured those women onto the bed, they had eighteen kinds of artistry to keep those women unable to forget them.

The sounds from next door grew louder and louder, more and more unruly—not only women's voices, but even men's sounds mingled in.

Shen Shizou sat at the table reading a book, posture upright, back straight, but those enchanting phoenix eyes carried a few traces of inexplicable unease.

He naturally knew what the people next door were doing. For companions like them, being kept was naturally for those kinds of matters. But from the moment that woman had claimed him to now, a full three days had already passed.

Three full days.

At first there had still been maids coming to see him. The maid called Qiuyue had taught him the three obediences and four virtues, taught him how to win a woman's favor, taught him how to bow before the Madam. But that maid hadn't come in a long time either.

Every other companion went at it without stopping each night. Only his room here was quiet, as if completely forgotten.

Had she forgotten him?

Shen Shizou felt as if he were on his way to attend a grand appointment he had long prepared for, but that woman had not come.

He had no right or standing to begin with to demand that woman come see him.

But Shen Shizou had always remembered the words that woman had said to him, and in that dim, dark room, the look of tender heartache in the woman's eyes when she reached out and touched the scars on his face.

No one had ever looked at him with that kind of gaze before.

That woman should care about him.

Shen Shizou's fingertips repeatedly rubbed the corners of the page until the paper was creased. He thought about it, yet felt that this caring was like flowers reflected in water and the moon in the mirror—beautiful and dreamlike when viewed from afar, but shattered into nothing the moment one reached out to touch it.

A little companion kept in Gongzi Garden—what standing did he have to speak of anything else?

Shen Shizou thought for a long time. Finally he got up from his seat and walked back to the bed, wanting to lie down and rest. But the moment he had just lain down, someone suddenly knocked at his door.

Shen Shizou furrowed his brow and didn't move. The person outside kept knocking, and then said with a laugh: "It's me, not a female guest."

It was the companion who lived next door.

Shen Shizou got up and opened the door, and saw a bright, striking face. The other man's collar was half open, revealing an ambiguous stretch of skin. He smiled and said: "Sorry, I must have disturbed your reading just now."

Shen Shizou pressed his thin lips together and gave a cold "mm," said nothing in return, only raked the other man's face with his gaze, gesturing for him to get to the point quickly.

The other man found his stone-faced expression amusing and laughed all the more freely: "Your female guest hasn't come to see you in quite a few days, has she? Come, let big brother give you something good. Learn this, and as long as she comes to see you even once, she's guaranteed to never be able to leave you."

Before Shen Shizou had even reacted, the other man had already passed over a booklet and stuffed it directly into Shen Shizou's arms. He added "consider it an apology for disturbing you," and then walked away.

Shen Shizou frowned and flipped through it twice. In an instant, a flush spread from his neck all the way to his earlobes.

It turned out to be a volume of spring palace illustrations—complete with annotations and personal reviews.

——

The sounds of strings and woodwinds from Gongzi Garden couldn't drift as far as the Lotus Courtyard of the General's residence. But those in Lotus Courtyard tonight were also awake through the entire night.

Having spent half the night on it, Bai Yunhe had finally ferreted out the maid who had laced Qin Shanyue's wine with aphrodisiac incense, and had invited Bai Qingning to listen in.

chapters.title: Thirteen
chapters.content:
When Bai Qingning arrived, everyone was already present. Zhao Hongzhu had washed up and changed into fresh clothes. Lancao stood at Zhao Hongzhu's side. Qin Shanyue and Bai Yunhe sat in the main seats at the front of the hall, and Bai Qingning took her seat below Bai Yunhe.

After Bai Qingning was seated, a maid was pushed forward by a matron and made to kneel before everyone.

That maid was just sixteen years old this year, with delicate features. When she was brought over and made to kneel, her face was full of panic, but she didn't deny anything. She cleanly admitted that she was the one who had administered the drug.

"This servant has long admired the General. This servant knows she is unworthy of the General, and in a moment of madness, drugged the General." The maid said tremblingly: "After this servant administered the drug, she became frightened and didn't dare go to the side room to find the General. Later this servant heard that something had happened at the banquet and was scared—it seems this servant had accidentally harmed someone else."

The maid's words seemed to be nothing more than a recounting of what she herself had done, yet they happened to address precisely what everyone most wanted to know. After finishing, the maid prostrated herself on the ground and kowtowed toward Bai Qingning.

"Madam, this servant made a mistake in a moment of madness. This servant begs Madam to spare this servant's life, out of consideration for the years this servant has served!"

As that maid began kowtowing, Bai Qingning held her teacup and raised her eyes to survey the expressions on everyone's faces.

Both Zhao Hongzhu and Lancao wore ashen faces. Qin Shanyue's expression was grim, his gaze cold and sharp, eyes fixed hard on the maid kneeling on the ground. Beside him, Bai Yunhe slapped the table with a sharp crack, and roared in an icy voice: "Conspiring to harm the Vice Minister of Justice—what audacity!"

The maid startled for a moment and instinctively glanced at Zhao Hongzhu.

Seeing this, Bai Qingning couldn't help but curve the corners of her lips.

This maid had known from the very beginning that she was a "scapegoat." She knew she was to drug the General, and she also knew Zhao Hongzhu would enter that side room. In the end, she would step forward to take the blame. Zhao Hongzhu had probably promised her certain things beforehand—something like: once it's done I'll protect you, I'll give you enough silver to leave, and so on.

Zhao Hongzhu must have promised a considerable sum. Combined with the Old Madam's deliberate indulgence, that's why this maid had been tempted.

In her past life, Bai Qingning had paid no attention to any of this, because by this time she had been struck into a stupor of despair, wishing she could drown herself in the lake. This maid had probably escaped safely. But in this lifetime, there was no escaping for this maid.

And no one could protect her.

"This servant does not know of any Vice Minister of Justice." The maid panicked and kowtowed repeatedly, hastily repeating her earlier words—nothing more than the same few lines.

This servant has long admired the General, and in a moment of clouded judgment, drugged the General, but this servant suddenly became frightened and didn't go to the side room. This servant knows she was wrong and begs Madam's forgiveness.

The maid also confessed specific information about the medicine woman she had gone to purchase the drug from, saying that one investigation would prove she was the one who bought it.

Every time the maid said this, Qin Shanyue's expression darkened another shade.

He vaguely seemed to recall that this maid had indeed come to serve him wine, but afterward a servant boy had come to serve dishes, and in the course of clearing and replacing the table setting, it had ended up on Bai Yunhe's table.

"You say you drugged the General—then why was it Lord Bai who ultimately drank that cup of wine?" Bai Qingning asked the maid.

The maid froze at these words: "It—it was Lord Bai who drank the wine?"

She looked in panic toward Bai Yunhe at the front of the hall, and once again glanced at Zhao Hongzhu, her gaze faintly betraying bewilderment and a silent plea for help.

But this time, Zhao Hongzhu raised her eyes and shot the maid a cold, hard glare.

The maid was so startled she lowered her head and didn't dare look at Zhao Hongzhu again, only trembling from head to toe as she explained: "This servant doesn't know. This servant drugged the General. This servant truly doesn't know."

Things seemed to have reached a stalemate.

Qin Shanyue abruptly rose to his feet and called out all the servant boys in the courtyard. He was going to go through them one by one to find the servant boy who had switched the wine from one table to another.

But Bai Qingning stopped him.

"General, please wait." Bai Qingning spoke up: "Just now Lancao said it was a maid from my courtyard who went to summon Zhao Hongzhu to the side room to find you. Then let us please also have Lancao identify her—which maid it was, at what hour, and who was there to bear witness."

As Bai Qingning spoke, Lancao's face turned deathly pale as she looked at her. Bai Qingning met Lancao's gaze with smiling eyes and, under Lancao's terrified stare, said in a soft and gentle voice: "Every maid in my courtyard has a matron specifically watching over them, and every one of them was so busy inside the courtyard they couldn't spare themselves. I truly don't know who could have specifically gone to Warm Fragrance Pavilion to deliver a message to you and your mistress. Lancao, you'd best look carefully in a moment. If you happen to pick a maid who was helping out in Lotus Courtyard the whole time, with no opportunity to slip away, and with people to vouch for her—then it would mean you've told a lie."

Under Bai Qingning's gaze, Lancao gradually felt her back grow damp with cold sweat.

What if she picked the wrong one—

——

That night in Lotus Courtyard, no one slept.

Qin Shanyue went through every single servant boy before finding the one who had switched the cups. The other party only said he had moved a tray in passing while serving a dish to a neighboring table, and hadn't noticed the cup on the tray.

That servant boy knelt on the ground sobbing and kowtowing: "This servant truly didn't know there was poison in that cup of wine. This servant was only clearing a tray, and accidentally mixed up the wine cup on the table. This servant truly didn't know!"

Qin Shanyue's expression grew even darker. This thread looked like a coincidence, but could things really be that coincidental?

He walked with heavy steps into Lotus Courtyard. In front of the garden, two rows of maids stood in neat order, all with their faces raised. And Lancao stood before those two rows of maids, her eyes vacant as they swept across each maid's face.

These were all the maids of Bai Qingning's Lotus Courtyard.

"Can you make out who it was?" Bai Qingning stood to the side, a light gauze fan twirling in her fingers, speaking unhurriedly from behind: "Is it that you can't recognize her, or that you don't dare pick? Are you afraid of choosing wrong?"

As Qin Shanyue drew near, Lancao collapsed to her knees beside Zhao Hongzhu with a thud, and sobbed: "Miss, this servant truly cannot remember who it was anymore. She only seems vaguely familiar, but this servant can't remember."

Zhao Hongzhu looked at Qin Shanyue as he approached, her eyes brimming with tears, and pleaded: "Brother Qin, Lancao can't remember who came to notify us. Please don't blame Lancao. It's all my fault. I shouldn't have gone to that side room. Please don't blame Lancao, alright?"

"What utter nonsense!" Bai Yunhe stood to one side, listening until he nearly laughed from exasperation: "Lancao can't remember which maid it was, yet she's certain it was definitely a maid from Lotus Courtyard—if that isn't framing and slander, then what is? You, Zhao Hongzhu! Do you think that by putting on a tearful face, this matter will just blow over? From beginning to end, you haven't produced a single shred of evidence, yet you come here to make a scene and muddy the waters. You truly are an offense to this official's ears! In this matter I shall absolutely ask my father-in-law to intervene personally and restore my innocence!"

As Bai Yunhe said all this, Bai Qingning stood where she was and curved a cold smile.

In her past life at this very moment, she had been left spinning and completely defeated by Zhao Hongzhu's schemes. When she went to seek help from the Bai family, they only told her to endure. Now that all of this had landed on Bai Yunhe's own head, Bai Yunhe suddenly knew better than to endure.

Until the slap landed on his own face, he had no idea it could hurt.

chapters.title: Fourteen
chapters.content:
"Lord Bai." At this moment, Qin Shanyue, standing at the courtyard entrance, finally spoke.

He first dismissed everyone. After all the maids and servant boys had left, Qin Shanyue raised his eyes to look at Bai Yunhe.

"This matter is a private affair of the Qin household, and involves the hidden secrets of the inner quarters. It is I, Qin, who have wronged you." Qin Shanyue said in a hoarse voice: "What remains, I will handle myself, and I will certainly give Lord Bai a satisfactory answer."

This was essentially showing him the door.

Bai Yunhe was naturally displeased in his heart. He had been put through such an ordeal today and had nearly lost half his life, yet Qin Shanyue wanted to smooth everything over!

A surge of rage circled in Bai Yunhe's chest. He wanted to erupt in anger, but forced it down.

The Qin family had generations of meritorious service, and Qin Shanyue was the only second-rank general in court. He could not afford to offend him.

So he coldly flicked his sleeves, let out an angry snort, glanced once at Bai Qingning, and turned to leave.

Bai Qingning naturally understood what Bai Yunhe meant—once everything had settled, she would still need to make a trip to the Bai family estate and explain everything that had happened and how it had ended to Bai Yunhe.

After Bai Yunhe left, the courtyard was left with only four people—three standing and one kneeling.

Lancao still hadn't risen from the ground, and Qin Shanyue no longer had any attention to spare for Lancao. His gaze swept over Bai Qingning and Zhao Hongzhu in turn. Both were women he held dear, yet looking at either of them, he felt they were no longer as they once had been.

His white moonlight had been stained with mud. His cinnabar mole had been clouded with dust.

That servant boy who had inexplicably switched the cups, and Bai Yunhe who had suddenly been drugged and ended up in the side room—clearly someone had been meddling from behind the scenes. And the maid who had drugged Qin Shanyue and the Lancao who had jumped out to slander Bai Qingning were not clean either. Qin Shanyue was no fool. To have risen to this official position, beyond his near-divine skill in commanding troops, he himself was also very shrewd.

He quickly realized that neither of these two women was innocent.

Both had made their moves. One had won, and one had lost.

This filled Qin Shanyue's heart with tremendous anguish. He was unwilling to admit it, yet he absolutely could not deny it.

His two most beloved women had waged a battle against each other because of him. On this battlefield without smoke, all three of them were covered in wounds.

"Enough." Qin Shanyue closed his eyes and said wearily: "Let us stop here for tonight. Hongzhu, you should return to Warm Fragrance Pavilion for now."

This was to send Zhao Hongzhu away—clearly he had something to say to Bai Qingning.

"Wait." Bai Qingning held her fan and raised her eyes toward Zhao Hongzhu, who had lost this round and was holding herself together through sheer will: "Has Miss Zhao forgotten something? Your maid—she only received the face slapping. There are still twenty rod strikes outstanding."

Zhao Hongzhu's complexion was already dreadful. Hearing this, her whole body swayed and she nearly collapsed to her knees on the spot.

Lancao was like a sister to her. How could she bear to let Lancao be beaten?

Zhao Hongzhu instinctively looked toward Qin Shanyue.

Qin Shanyue's expression had already darkened to the color of dirt. He said nothing with a cold face, clearly displeased with Bai Qingning's ruthlessness.

But Bai Qingning didn't care in the slightest. So what if Qin Shanyue was unhappy? She would do it anyway.

She stood in the moonlight, and without the slightest restraint, curved a smile at Zhao Hongzhu: "Miss Zhao, without rules there is no order. Your servant couldn't produce any evidence, so she must accept my punishment. Otherwise, where does that leave the dignity of the Qin household?"

Zhao Hongzhu saw it clearly.

Bai Qingning was determined to have Lancao's life today.

She would not rest until she did.

Zhao Hongzhu suddenly felt regret.

Why had she provoked Bai Qingning?

Had she known this woman was so ruthless and merciless, she would never have dared to step into the General's residence so recklessly!

At that moment, the Lotus Courtyard was so quiet that only the sound of Lancao trembling remained. Since Qin Shanyue wouldn't speak, Zhao Hongzhu couldn't protect Lancao. Bai Qingning called over two matrons and had Lancao dragged over to begin the beating.

Besides Lancao, there was also the maid who had drugged Qin Shanyue earlier.

Lancao was to receive twenty rod strikes. That maid was a bond servant whose life and death depended entirely on the will of the Qin family's masters. She had committed such a grave offense, so Bai Qingning sentenced her directly to fifty rod strikes.

Ten rod strikes could leave a person's flesh a bloody mess. Once a high fever set in, a person could easily burn to death. Even if they survived, they would be bedridden for a full month.

Twenty rod strikes meant walking the line between life and death, leaving lifelong illness and pain.

Fifty rod strikes was enough to beat the lower half of a person's body into pulp and shredded flesh. Death was certain, and it would be an agonizing death.

Since Bai Qingning had taken charge of the Qin household, she had always been lenient with people and rarely used physical punishment. Such a rod-striking sentence was a first. Quite a few maids snuck out from the side rooms to watch the commotion, peering this way from behind several trees. Every time they heard a scream, the whole group would shudder.

From where they watched, Lotus Courtyard was lit up bright as day. Two maids lay draped over a low stool being beaten together. The rod came down hard against flesh, almost as if it would shatter their bones. By the third strike, Lancao had gone still.

The other maid also couldn't hold on by the third strike. She threw her head back and cried out: "It wasn't me who administered the drug! It was Zhao Hongzhu who told me to do it! It was Zhao Hongzhu who told me to! Madam, spare this servant's life! Spare this servant's life!"

"Is that so?" Bai Qingning stood to the side with her fan in her arms, watching this bloody spectacle, and looked at Zhao Hongzhu with a smile in her eyes: "Miss Zhao, did you hear what she said?"

Zhao Hongzhu had been watching Lancao's punishment through tears. At these words she raised her head, and looked at Bai Qingning with ferocious eyes.

The hatred in the depths of her heart was so intense that Zhao Hongzhu couldn't conceal it at all. Yet Bai Qingning seemed not to care in the slightest, waiting with a smiling expression for her answer.

What did hatred matter?

You lost. You have to accept it.

Those rod strikes rang out one after another in Bai Qingning's ears, making her mind drift to Qiuyue from her past life—that foolish maid of hers had also been beaten to death just like this, strike by strike. Now it was Lancao's turn. Zhao Hongzhu, open your eyes and look. All of this is the evil you have done. Now, I am returning it to you, piece by piece.

That maid was still screaming shrilly, lying over the stool and crying for mercy at the top of her voice: "Miss Zhao! Say something! It was you who told this servant to do it! This servant is just a maid—how would this servant dare set her sights on a master! It was you who gave this servant silver and promised to let this servant out of the household!"

At first the maid still harbored the illusion that Zhao Hongzhu would speak up and admit it, beg for her pardon. But the rod strikes came down harder and harder, her breath grew fainter and fainter. By the end she no longer hoped to be saved, and simply lay over the low stool, cursing Zhao Hongzhu over and over again.

Amid those curses, Zhao Hongzhu bit her lips and countered with fading breath: "I don't know what she's talking about. She's slandering me."

Even if everyone knew it was true, Zhao Hongzhu could not admit it.

The moment she admitted it, Zhao Hongzhu would be completely finished.

chapters.title: Fifteen
chapters.content:
Bai Qingning hadn't planned to make Zhao Hongzhu admit anything either, because Zhao Hongzhu had covered her tracks cleanly enough. And with the Old Madam and Qin Shanyue both willfully biased in her favor, plus the Zhao family's case about to be overturned and Zhao Hongzhu soon to be swept into a court power struggle, she had no way to finish Zhao Hongzhu off.

But for now, this was enough.

The revenge for her past life had, at this point, finally been half repaid.

"That makes sense, I suppose." The smile on Bai Qingning's face grew softer. Bathed in a sky full of starlight and the thin, cool moonlight, against a backdrop of heartrending screams, she let out a light laugh: "Miss Zhao would naturally never stoop to such methods. These maids were simply deluding themselves with wild imaginings."

Having said that, Bai Qingning paid no further attention to anyone remaining. She turned and walked directly back into Lotus Courtyard, each step accompanied by the sounds of agonized wailing.

No one dared follow her in. The General had long since dismissed everyone. As she lifted her skirts and walked alone into the inner part of Lotus Courtyard, she saw Qin Shanyue still standing in the same spot.

He seemed not to have moved at all—his back to everyone, standing there just like that.

Bai Qingning stopped her steps from a distance, curtsied toward Qin Shanyue, and said softly: "General, is there something you wish to say to me?"

When Qin Shanyue heard Bai Qingning's voice, his whole body trembled. Then he slowly turned around and looked at Bai Qingning with an expression she had never seen before—three parts disappointment, two parts exhaustion, and the rest a tangle of various mixed emotions.

Bai Qingning heard Qin Shanyue ask: "It was you, wasn't it? To take revenge on Zhao Hongzhu, you were willing to drag even your own brother into it. Why? Qingning, I made you a promise—I told you I would never marry her, that I would only want you. Why did you still have to destroy her?"

"And today you wouldn't even let her maid off! Qingning, do you hate her to such a degree? What exactly did she do wrong? I was the one who brought her back. If you had any grievances, you could have told me. Why did you have to ruin her in this way!"

When Qin Shanyue spoke his last words, his sharp phoenix eyes were filled with regret: "I thought you were a good woman who could understand me—that's why I brought her back. Bai Qingning, you have truly disappointed me."

In the moonlight, Qin Shanyue furrowed his brows and looked at Bai Qingning as if seeing her for the first time. He had originally been moved by Bai Qingning's gentleness and thoughtfulness. But upon returning this time, he found that Bai Qingning had completely changed. The image of the woman who used to sit in the water pavilion of Lotus Courtyard playing the guqin had grown blurry in his memory, as if everything had been slowly drifting away.

"I have disappointed the General?" The woman in the moonlight raised her face with a smile, her voice still soft and melodious. But as the words fell, their trailing note tilted up with mockery: "Then what does the General think I should have done, so that you would not be disappointed? Should I have let Zhao Hongzhu climb into your bed? Should I have smiled and watched the two of you carry on together? Should I have asked to be demoted myself? Should I have cleared space and made room? Should I have endured a servant's insults toward me without a word? Should I have knelt on the ground and let all of them trample over my head? Is that right?"

Every word Bai Qingning spoke was gentle and soft in tone, yet those words fell on Qin Shanyue's ears like sharp blades, piercing his chest until it bled. He instinctively retorted: "I never thought any of that."

Bai Qingning let out a sardonic laugh.

Yes. You never thought any of that. And in my past life, neither did I—and I ended up with my bones buried under a snowfield.

If she didn't fight back, she would be chopped up like fish on a cutting board. If she did fight back, someone would point at her nose and say "you have truly disappointed me." Either way, everything was her fault. None of it could be blamed on Zhao Hongzhu.

"The General never thought any of that—then what is the General thinking right now?" Bai Qingning walked across the neat seams between the paving stones. Moonlight washed over her skirts as she moved step by step forward, as if descending from that snowfield of her past life, walking up to the man she had deeply loved yet who had failed her. Mustering all her strength, she wanted to ask only one thing: "The General speaks again and again of being disappointed in me. But are you disappointed in Zhao Hongzhu? I may have done those despicable things—but didn't Zhao Hongzhu as well? She drugged you with an aphrodisiac. Could you truly not tell? You don't go to her—so why do you come to me?"

And in my past life, she was the one who did wrong too. Were you ever disappointed in her? You weren't. You still married her. And let me die.

Qin Shanyue listened to Bai Qingning's words. Even the veins on his forehead trembled. He said through gritted teeth: "Bai Qingning, are you admitting this was your doing?"

"I admit nothing." Bai Qingning smiled gently at Qin Shanyue. In the moonlight, her jade face glowed like rosy clouds. She said: "Zhao Hongzhu won't admit to what she's done—so on what grounds does the General force me to admit to mine? As long as she refuses to confess for one day, I refuse to confess for one day. And even if the General knows it was me—what of it? If the General doesn't wish to punish her, then don't even think about punishing me."

From the very beginning, Bai Qingning had known this matter couldn't be hidden from Qin Shanyue. There were only so few people in the Qin household. With even the slightest thread to follow, his thinking would lead back to her. She had cleaned up the evidence well enough, but the justice of this world required evidence—the human heart did not.

Qin Shanyue would hold her responsible in his heart. He would resent her at every moment. He would remember forever what she had done. He would rage over it. And because of this, his heart would drift further from hers.

But that was precisely what she wanted.

"Bai Qingning!" Qin Shanyue suddenly let out an explosive shout, his entire body's sharp killing aura surging straight toward Bai Qingning's face: "Do you know what you're doing? You have committed one of the seven grounds for divorce. I can repudiate you!"

After Qin Shanyue shouted these words, he fixed Bai Qingning with a cold, sharp gaze, waiting for her to yield.

This was the harshest punishment he could think of to use against Bai Qingning. Bai Qingning loved him so deeply—she would naturally never leave him.

He could no longer reason with Bai Qingning. Right now he only wanted Bai Qingning to bow her head and admit her fault, and he would confine Bai Qingning to Lotus Courtyard as punishment. Until this matter was resolved, she needn't dream of leaving.

But when Qin Shanyue finished speaking, he did not see any panic or agitation on Bai Qingning's face. On the contrary, Bai Qingning stood in the moonlight and simply cast him one cool, detached glance.

A bad premonition suddenly welled up in Qin Shanyue's heart.

Like a kite whose string had snapped, everything was flying off in a direction beyond his control.

"Very well." A gentle woman's voice drifted through the moonlight, and it sounded almost like laughter.

The string in Qin Shanyue's mind snapped taut. He abruptly raised his eyes to look at Bai Qingning, and suddenly barked sharply: "Bai Qingning! Do you know what you're saying? Are you truly determined to fight me on this—willing to be repudiated rather than admit your fault?"

chapters.title: Sixteen
chapters.content:
"Was it not the General who first spoke of repudiating me? How has it become something I said?" Bai Qingning raised her eyes to look at Qin Shanyue. She had a pair of enchanting, limpid eyes, calm and clear as a still pond, as if no matter what she saw, not even half a ripple could be stirred in them.

"Qingning is not quarreling with the General either." Bai Qingning continued: "What the General promised me was a lifetime of devotion, just the two of us. If today the General can no longer keep that promise, then don't drag things out any further. A clean break is better for us both."

When Qin Shanyue heard these words, the fire he had been suppressing the entire day suddenly erupted. His voice rose with each sentence: "In what way have I ever let you down! Bai Qingning, I have already explained to you—I brought Zhao Hongzhu back only to help clear her name. Between Zhao Hongzhu and myself, I have always kept propriety and never overstepped! Why must you press so relentlessly!"

"Never overstepped?" A sharp laugh escaped Bai Qingning's throat: "That night you spent half the night in Zhao Hongzhu's Warm Fragrance Pavilion—did you think I didn't know? Qin Shanyue, tell me—if you never overstepped, what were you doing there for half a night?"

When Qin Shanyue heard Bai Qingning bring up that half a night, his mind was instantly thrown into chaos.

What had he done?

He had kept vigil at Zhao Hongzhu's bedside, watching her struggle through nightmares. Even if he did have feelings for Zhao Hongzhu, he could swear before heaven that he had never overstepped even half a step!

"I have never done anything to wrong you."

With nothing to argue against, Qin Shanyue could only repeat this sentence once more.

"Say whatever you wish, General." Bai Qingning lifted her skirts and walked toward Lotus Courtyard, and as she walked, she tossed back a parting word: "I await the General's letter of repudiation. If I do not receive it by tomorrow, I will spread the matter of Zhao Hongzhu and Bai Yunhe until it is known by all."

"Bai Yunhe has a father-in-law he cannot afford to offend. Today no one saw him, so if this matter doesn't involve him, it can simply pass. But if he is dragged into the open, then for the sake of his reputation and future, Bai Yunhe will certainly confess everything to his future father-in-law and seek his help. Once the Minister of Justice becomes entangled in this, the matter won't end until everyone has had a layer of skin peeled off. The General needn't dream of smoothing things over."

Having said that, Bai Qingning didn't spare Qin Shanyue so much as a glance, and simply stepped forward into Lotus Courtyard.

Qin Shanyue stood there, chest suffocated by Bai Qingning's words. He stared at Bai Qingning's retreating figure with bloodshot eyes, and for the first time in his heart, feelings of resentment toward Bai Qingning arose.

How could Bai Qingning be so ruthless?

Qin Shanyue felt as if he were being driven to madness. He had never imagined that matters of the inner household could descend into such shameful disorder. He paced his way out of Lotus Courtyard and wandered through the Qin residence in a daze. Without realizing it, he had walked his way to the outside of Warm Fragrance Pavilion.

He had only just arrived at the entrance of Warm Fragrance Pavilion when he heard a commotion of panicked voices from within. A maid came running out, screaming: "Something terrible has happened! Something terrible! Miss Zhao has hanged herself!"

Qin Shanyue's heart seized in an instant. He didn't even have time to ask another question before he was striding quickly toward Warm Fragrance Pavilion. The wind stirred up in his wake sent the courtyard's near-fading flowers swaying gently.

When he stepped inside Warm Fragrance Pavilion, everything was in chaos. Three senior maids surrounded Zhao Hongzhu on the floor in a panic. Zhao Hongzhu wore nothing but a white undergarment, her complexion a bluish purple, a livid bruise threaded with burst blood vessels encircling her neck.

That neck was slender and pale, which made the strangulation mark all the more horrifying. Zhao Hongzhu lay huddled on the floor coughing, each sound as if it were wrenching Qin Shanyue's very heart and lungs out of his chest.

Qin Shanyue rushed over and gathered Zhao Hongzhu up from the floor into his arms. Zhao Hongzhu, struggling to breathe, let out a gasping sound like an animal on the verge of death, and Qin Shanyue's eyes suddenly reddened.

"Hongzhu." He laid Zhao Hongzhu horizontally on the bed. Zhao Hongzhu's slender body kept trembling. He couldn't help but hold her close and murmur soothingly at her ear: "It's alright now. It's alright."

"Lancao is dead." The tears in the depths of Zhao Hongzhu's eyes fell like snapped pearls. Her neck, which she had always held high with pride, drooped as if a bone had been removed. She trembled, her fingers hooking around Qin Shanyue's iron wristguard, lying on her side on the bed. In a faint voice she said: "Shanyue, do you still remember the first time we met in secret?"

Qin Shanyue naturally remembered.

When he was young, he had first met and befriended the Zhao family's elder brother at the academy. The elder brother had invited him to the Zhao residence. The first time he went to the Zhao family, he saw Zhao Hongzhu beneath a pavilion by the water.

A girl in brilliant red robes was chatting and laughing with a maid. The two of them were talking about something—and then the girl threw back her head and laughed with clear, bright laughter.

Qin Shanyue was told that this girl was the Zhao family's eldest legitimate daughter, vivacious and spirited from childhood, unlike the timid girls of other households. She was skilled at polo, excelled at poetry and song, and could even wield a sword.

The moment he saw her, he was drawn in by that sweep of red.

He had racked his brains to compose two stiff, lovesick poems and sent them to Zhao Hongzhu. Afterward he felt he had been too forward. But what he hadn't expected was that Zhao Hongzhu came to find him directly.

They met in the narrow alley behind the Zhao family's back gate, with Lancao keeping watch just outside. Every time someone passed, Lancao would anxiously stamp her feet. Back then Qin Shanyue was not yet a General, and Lancao would call him "Young Master Qin."

Those calls of "Young Master Qin" had rung out in the alleyways, in the small garden of the Zhao residence, in the imperial hunting grounds on autumn days. Every time they met, Lancao would hide nearby keeping watch for them.

But now, Lancao was dead.

The girl who had grown up alongside Zhao Hongzhu since childhood, who had survived the ransacking and destruction of the family, who had endured the bitter winds of the northern frontier—she was dead. She hadn't died at the hands of bandits. She had died instead in the scheming shadows of the inner household.

For no clear reason, Qin Shanyue felt a lump rising in his throat. The resentment toward Bai Qingning in his heart deepened by several more degrees.

"Shanyue, it was I who administered the drug." At this moment, Zhao Hongzhu suddenly spoke.

Qin Shanyue stared at Zhao Hongzhu in stunned silence.

Within the pale pink gauze curtains, Zhao Hongzhu lay among the sumptuous silks, like a phoenix butterfly that could dissolve at any moment. With no trace of life in her voice she said: "I missed you too much. I have never forgotten you. These three years, I have always wanted to return to your side. But you had fallen in love with another woman. I had no other way—I could only use such a disgusting method to stay."

"All I wanted was so little. Between you and her, I was willing to yield. I know I am the most despicable and contemptible one, so I never dared to ask for much. It's just that I hadn't expected her to be so absolute about it—she left me no path to survive at all."

As Zhao Hongzhu said this, she seemed unable to go on. She covered her face with one hand, her voice raw with grief: "Ziqin, all the Zhao family are already gone. I have been living on by any means until now, and I have lived long enough. And now Lancao is gone too. I have no place left in this world. I want to go with Lancao. Today's events were all my fault. Even if Madam was ruthless in her methods against me, she only wanted to keep you. From now on, forget me. Live well with Madam."

Zhao Hongzhu's words fell one by one. Every single word seemed feather-light, yet Qin Shanyue felt the weight on his shoulders grow heavier and heavier—as though the entire weight of a woman's life had been pressed down upon him.

If Zhao Hongzhu had kept denying it was her doing, perhaps he would not feel this wretched. But Zhao Hongzhu was here before him now, laying herself open completely, telling him with an air of absolute resolution—I truly did this. But the reason I did it was because of you. I wanted to stay by your side. I love you. I cannot leave you.

Everything Zhao Hongzhu had done was because she loved him.

Qin Shanyue knew what Zhao Hongzhu had done was wrong. But could love really be sorted into right and wrong? Zhao Hongzhu had only wanted to stay by his side. From beginning to end, all she had wanted was that little. Yet all of it had been destroyed by Bai Qingning.

And what Bai Qingning had destroyed was far more than just Zhao Hongzhu.

If not for Bai Qingning, how could they have been driven to this desperate place today?

Looking at Zhao Hongzhu's face, utterly drained of life, a dull ache surged through Qin Shanyue's chest. He pressed Zhao Hongzhu hard against his chest, his eyes faintly reddening. He said: "Hongzhu, don't die."

"I have no path left to live." Zhao Hongzhu smiled with bleak desolation: "After today, I am ruined in name and standing. Even if the Zhao family's case is overturned, where could I go afterward? I have no wish to live out my days in some decrepit temple. Better to find a place to die, and spare myself the contempt of others in the years to come."

Since ancient times, how many women who had lost their purity had come to a good end? Being drowned in a pig cage would be considered nothing less than deserved. After today, those noble ladies might say nothing to her face, but behind her back they would all spit on her name. She could never hold her head up again.

She was no longer that pampered, legitimate daughter of a noble family.

And all of this—it was because she loved him. It was because of Bai Qingning.

Qin Shanyue felt the tenderness and pity surging in his chest like wildfire out of control. His very scalp went numb in waves. And in one unguarded moment, the words left his lips before he could stop them: "I will marry you."

chapters.title: Seventeen
chapters.content:
Zhao Hongzhu's entire body went rigid.

Like someone grabbing onto a lifesaving straw, she pressed her whole self into Qin Shanyue's embrace. But the moment she touched him, tears streamed down her face.

"I am not clean anymore." She said: "I am soiled. If you take me, who knows how many people will point at your back and mock you."

"It doesn't matter. I don't care about any of that." Qin Shanyue's heart ached all the more. He wrapped his arms around Zhao Hongzhu and held her tight, and as she sobbed, his voice was resolute: "As long as they don't scold you, I am willing to shield you from the wind and rain forever."

He knew that marrying a woman whose reputation was in ruins would invite mockery behind his back. But it didn't matter. He was willing to let those people point at him—as long as it made Zhao Hongzhu's life easier.

This was Qin Shanyue's love—enduring and profound, as vast and sheltering as a mountain.

As long as he was steadfast in loving a person, he could bear all things, just to make that person happy.

"The Old Madam won't agree either." Zhao Hongzhu shook her head: "Even though the Old Madam is fond of me, she would never allow someone like me—a wilted and fallen flower—to enter the Qin household. She would feel I would dirty the Qin family's standing."

"Don't worry." Qin Shanyue tightened his grip on Zhao Hongzhu's hand: "I will speak to the Old Madam. As for the man in the side room—I will personally go to Bai Yunhe and make him keep silent. I will give you the three letters and six rites, bring you through the door in an eight-bearer palanquin, and properly welcome you in as my equal wife."

"No, you cannot marry me." Zhao Hongzhu was still crying, but she was no longer collapsed on the bed. She pressed herself into Qin Shanyue's embrace, her cheek tight against his chest, trembling as she spoke: "Bai Qingning will not let this go. She has something to hold over me. She can destroy me in any number of ways. As long as she remains in the Qin household for one day, I have no path to live."

Qin Shanyue held Zhao Hongzhu even tighter.

"Don't be afraid." Qin Shanyue exhaled heavily, as if summoning great resolve. In one moment, he shut his eyes hard, and with great difficulty squeezed out the words from his throat: "I will...send her to the estate first."

The words "I will repudiate her" circled in his throat and ultimately could not be said aloud.

Qin Shanyue still did not want to repudiate Bai Qingning.

There was still a place for Bai Qingning in Qin Shanyue's heart. And what's more, he did not truly believe Bai Qingning would actually leave him.

Qin Shanyue knew Bai Qingning. Bai Qingning loved him to the marrow of her bones. Her talk of separation now was most likely just her anger talking. When he truly produced a letter of repudiation, Bai Qingning would naturally regret it.

What could Bai Qingning do after leaving the Qin household? She would be nothing more than a cast-off woman. Even if the Bai family sheltered her, no one would want her anymore.

So he decided to take back last night's words. He could give Bai Qingning one more chance.

Something like keeping Bai Qingning temporarily at an outside estate. Once Bai Qingning regretted what she had done and admitted her mistakes, he could consider bringing her back.

As Qin Shanyue's words fell, Zhao Hongzhu clasped her arms tightly around his neck. She rested her head on his shoulder, buried her face against his chest, and slowly, through the remnants of tears, gave a soft "mm."

Qin Shanyue could not see Zhao Hongzhu's expression, and naturally could not see the cold gleam that flashed through the depths of her eyes.

Bai Qingning still did not know Qin Shanyue well enough after all. In love, a woman's greatest leverage was the man's devoted favoritism.

She had been losing the entire day today. But in the final critical moment, she had finally turned it around.

Zhao Hongzhu drew a deep breath and slowly pressed Qin Shanyue down onto the bed.

She had to strike while the iron was hot. She absolutely could not stop.

If Qin Shanyue didn't take her tonight, the next time Qin Shanyue came to her, he would still be mindful of what had happened before. She had to secure Qin Shanyue at this very moment.

Qin Shanyue made a brief attempt to resist. He had no real wish to be with Zhao Hongzhu at a time like this. But when Zhao Hongzhu looked at him with a face streaked with tears, Qin Shanyue could only let out a light sigh and wrap an arm around her shoulders.

He understood that Zhao Hongzhu's heart knot was here. Zhao Hongzhu feared that he would think her dirty.

He would not think her dirty. He would hold Zhao Hongzhu in the palm of his hand forever, always keeping her at the highest place. No dust or mud would be allowed to touch the hem of her skirts.

And so, Qin Shanyue gently drew Zhao Hongzhu down with him onto the bed.

That night, the bright moon hung high, quietly illuminating the many faces of the mortal world.

——

On the morning of the second day, Bai Qingning received word from the Bai family early in the morning—the First Madam missed her terribly, and asked her to return quickly for a visit.

Bai Qingning naturally knew this was nothing but a pretext. Bai Yunhe had gone back and recounted everything, and the Bai family couldn't sit still any longer. They wanted to ask Bai Qingning how exactly the situation stood.

Bai Qingning agreed and sent away the reporting maid, then called Chunri over and asked: "Where is the General?"

She wanted to know what had become of her letter of repudiation.

"The General—" A look of awkwardness washed over Chunri's face, as if she didn't quite know how to begin. When Bai Qingning raised her eyes to look at her, the hands clasped in front of her belly couldn't help but rub together, and she said in a low voice: "The General stayed the night at Warm Fragrance Pavilion. He went out to the palace early this morning. I heard from the maids at Warm Fragrance Pavilion that the General made a promise to Miss Zhao—that he will definitely marry her."

Bai Qingning's hand holding the teacup paused.

So Zhao Hongzhu had made another move.

Bai Qingning could already guess what Zhao Hongzhu would do. After everything that had happened, the only thing she could appeal to was Qin Shanyue's pity. Last night, she had surely spared no effort.

Zhao Hongzhu really was someone who could stand at the highest peak one moment and wallow in the mud the next. A person like her—no matter what circumstances she was thrown into, she would always find the path most suited to herself, and fight her way back step by step.

What a pity, then, that the person she had encountered was Bai Qingning.

"Understood." Bai Qingning withdrew her gaze, rose to her feet and said: "Call Qiuyue to come dress my hair. We are going to the Bai family estate."

Qiuyue had known there had been a great commotion in Lotus Courtyard the night before, so she hadn't slept well the entire night. When she woke the next morning, she had no energy at all. When Chunri called her over, Qiuyue came in yawning. She had just finished her curtsy to Bai Qingning and hadn't yet had the chance to ask "Madam, what on earth was happening in the courtyard last night—this servant heard two maids died," when she heard Bai Qingning say: "Put these away safely."

Qiuyue lowered her gaze and saw several gold ornaments laid out on the table before her.

"Madam, these are all fine pieces." Qiuyue stroked them admiringly and asked: "Why put them away?"

"Sell them for silver." Bai Qingning continued: "Tomorrow, the two of us will go and buy the mute slave back."

Qiuyue: Heaven help me!

Has keeping a companion at Gongzi Garden no longer satisfied Madam?

Madam is going to keep a kept man at home!

chapters.title: Eighteen
chapters.content:
Qiuyue's fair, delicate little face was scrunched up with jealousy.

Madam had never spent that much silver on her!

It was all that fox spirit's fault! He had completely bewitched Madam's soul!

"Yes, Madam." No matter how jealous she was on the inside, Qiuyue still had to properly put away the ornaments, then help Bai Qingning with her hair and makeup.

Today Bai Qingning wore an indigo留仙 flowing skirt, with a liquid-silver sash at her waist drawing out the graceful curve of her figure. In her hair she wore a green jade gilt hairpin. Her face was clear and cool as a mountain moon—detached and otherworldly. When she rose to her feet, an aura of radiant beauty moved with her, like a celestial maiden descending from the clouds, making one involuntarily still, for fear of startling an immortal.

Once dressed, Bai Qingning brought Qiuyue with her and returned to the Bai family estate.

Her father and Bai Yunhe had gone to court. Only the First Madam and her legitimate younger sister were home.

The First Madam wore a heavy deep red brocade dress embroidered with golden birds and a pleated skirt, with a large red pomegranate flower hairpin adorning her head. From a distance, she looked imposing and dignified.

The legitimate younger sister wore the white jade flower hairpin Bai Qingning had gifted her last time, dressed in a plain white long skirt. She had been sitting under the First Madam's instruction learning how to manage household accounts. When she saw Bai Qingning arrive, she stared at her with wide, expectant eyes.

Last time this married older half-sister had given her such an expensive, wonderful hairpin!

What a pity—there was none this time.

And because these matters were far too unseemly, the legitimate younger sister was sent straight back to her own courtyard by the First Madam. When Bai Qingning entered the inner quarters of the Bai family estate, she saw the First Madam seated in the chair at the front of the hall waiting for her. Upon seeing Bai Qingning, the First Madam pressed anxiously for her to explain what on earth had happened yesterday.

"I heard someone say there had been a great catastrophe at the Qin residence, that someone had done those shameful things in broad daylight. I hadn't taken it too seriously, but then your brother came home and told me—"

The First Madam thought of what her eldest son had said to her yesterday, and nearly fainted on the spot. Her fingers were practically shredding the embroidered handkerchief in her hands.

That wretched Zhao Hongzhu had actually climbed into her son's bed!

Her legitimate son had been raised to be upright and refined, graceful as a jade tree. He was destined to marry a noble lady of standing! How could a convicted criminal's daughter possibly be worthy of him? And by using such low, despicable means as drugging him!

"Mm." Bai Qingning picked up her teacup and nodded: "Some unseemly things did happen. Yesterday because of Zhao Hongzhu, Lotus Courtyard was in a commotion the whole night. What to do about it going forward still has no clear answer."

When Bai Qingning said this, the First Madam suddenly shot to her feet. Her well-maintained face contorted entirely, unable to maintain even a shred of a Madam's dignity. Her vivid red fingertips had turned white from being clenched so tight, and her voice rose involuntarily: "What do you mean no clear answer? If she's the one who administered the drug, then she should be punished accordingly! If we don't deal with her, are you expecting our Bai family to swallow this insult and have her marry in?"

"The Qin family side refuses to deal with her. Qin Shanyue and the Old Madam are both biased in her favor." Bai Qingning shook her head, putting on a troubled expression: "Mother, have you forgotten what you told me? This Miss Zhao is going to have her case overturned. She has the fate of ascending to great heights. Even in the Qin household I don't dare offend her. Mother, think about it calmly—if she were to marry into our Bai family, perhaps even His Majesty would raise our Bai family's standing along with it. You taught me all of this yourself. Now that it concerns you directly, why can't you see it clearly?"

With every sentence Bai Qingning spoke, the First Madam's face turned one shade greener. When Bai Qingning's last words fell, she also set down her teacup, raised her head, and put on an expression of genuine bewilderment, looking at the First Madam with perfect reasonableness.

You could tell me to endure it then. Now that it concerns your own son, why can't you endure it?

Didn't you say Zhao Hongzhu was someone who couldn't be offended? Didn't you say to bring Zhao Hongzhu into the household and tell me to get along with her properly? Why is it that you yourself can't manage that?

Bai Qingning's words left the First Madam nearly unable to breathe from fury. She sat in her chair, her face flushed crimson, and brought her fist down hard on the tea table beside her. The teacup jumped and splashed a few drops.

"How can these two things be the same!" The First Madam snapped back sharply: "Your eldest brother will be the pillar of the Bai family. His wife must be virtuous—how can he pick carelessly? You married into the Qin household. One more concubine is all it is, and she can't disrupt your household. It's nothing more than enduring a little hardship. How can that compare to your brother's situation?"

Bai Qingning showed nothing on her face, only inwardly letting out a cold laugh.

When all was said and done, it was still her own son who was precious. I am a concubine-born daughter who crawled out of a lesser woman's belly—not worth the Bai family's concern.

To the Bai family, she was nothing more than an instrument for weighing interests. Used when convenient, discarded in critical moments to exchange for power and influence.

But it didn't matter. In this lifetime, the one trapped in this particular mess would not be Bai Qingning.

"Then what should we do, Mother? If you don't want Brother to marry Zhao Hongzhu, what should we do?" Bai Qingning coaxed gently.

In truth, Bai Qingning knew perfectly well that Qin Shanyue would never marry Zhao Hongzhu off to Bai Yunhe. But she deliberately dangled this to stir up the First Madam's anxieties, to throw her into a state of agitation.

She knew the First Madam well. She was terrified of Zhao Hongzhu entering the Bai family's gates, dirtying the Bai family's standing, ruining her son's life. So the First Madam would certainly take some further action.

And when that time came, it would be the First Madam and the Qin household dogs snapping at each other.

Seeing her purpose achieved, Bai Qingning wasted no more time. After casually exchanging a few more words with the Bai family, she left. The sky was still early when she departed. She had brought no one else for today's visit, so she took Qiuyue for a stroll along the streets for two rounds, then walked into a pawnshop.

She had worn a bamboo hat upon entering the pawnshop, bargaining with the proprietor over the gold and silver jewelry, and ultimately exchanged them for a thousand taels of silver. Then she took Qiuyue—whose face was twisted in visible pain at every coin spent—and went to Gongzi Garden.

——

Gongzi Garden was not particularly lively during the day. Female guests rarely came at this hour, so the companions, with nothing to do, would gather together to chat and play music.

Living in the same garden, the companions were all closer to some and more distant from others. A group of them gathered together and began talking about recent goings-on in the garden.

"That one surnamed Shen at the far end—he hasn't been favored even once, has he?"

chapters.title: Nineteen
chapters.content:
"Strange, isn't it? He looks decent enough, his build is fine too. That female guest claimed him and gave him the most expensive room, so why has she not come to see him even once?"

"He's also someone who can stand being cooped up. Every day he just sits in his room reading books and poetry. He rarely comes out."

The voices downstairs were not particularly loud, but Shen Shizou had keen hearing. Sitting by the carved railing window in his second floor room, he could make out every word from below with perfect clarity.

"Could it be that the female guest has taken up with another companion? From the way she was dressed that day, she certainly doesn't seem like someone lacking for company."

"Or maybe she finds him insufficiently obedient and compliant? His temperament really is not very endearing."

"His face is passable though—counts as top quality."

"Are we short on good-looking men in Gongzi Garden? If that female guest comes again, I'm going to find a way to get a few words in with her. A guest like that—can't let her slip away."

"Exactly. Such a beautiful female guest—if it were me I'd go for it too. Why would she set her sights on that mute?"

The conversation downstairs grew more and more outrageous. Shen Shizou's brow furrowed tighter and tighter, and a strange restlessness spread through his body.

He thought back to his first meeting with Bai Qingning. Could it really be that his temperament was too disagreeable, and that was why Bai Qingning hadn't come to see him?

In a month's time, he would be going back to that narrow little room again.

But it didn't matter. He had never expected anything from that woman to begin with.

He was just thinking this when a commotion suddenly arose outside the door—someone seemed to be saying something like "she's here, she's here."

Shen Shizou's heart seized. He instinctively rose to his feet and looked down through his window.

The window was already half open. On the windowsill sat a flower pot with a clump of bright green grass growing in it. The moment you drew close, a faint grassy fragrance drifted up. As Shen Shizou leaned his upper body to the side, that clean, fresh scent reached him.

He looked down, and could see Bai Qingning's figure.

Bai Qingning wore a bamboo hat on her head and was walking over from a distance. The moment she stepped through the door, quite a few companions surged forward to greet her, clustering around her to speak.

Shen Shizou's heart gradually sank.

Every one of those companions had fine-looking faces and remarkable bearing, perfectly capable of playing the guqin or flute. Those surrounding Bai Qingning were all the names at the top of Gongzi Garden's roster.

Compared to these people, he seemed to have no advantage whatsoever.

The fingertips with which Shen Shizou gripped the wooden window gradually turned white. He slowly lowered the wooden window, shutting out the commotion from the floor below.

None of it had anything to do with him.

This wasn't what he had ever wanted in the first place. Once his injuries healed, he would find his own way to leave Gongzi Garden.

Shen Shizou settled back into his seat at the table and picked up his book to continue reading.

The words on the pages drifted through his mind like smoke, each one passing through without entering his thoughts at all. His fingers rubbed over the pages several times, creasing them into small wrinkles.

And then, footsteps sounded outside his door.

Shen Shizou's back suddenly went rigid. He stared at the book in his hands, thinking as he read—was that woman coming in? If she wanted to do those things with him, how was he going to refuse today?

Perhaps she wouldn't come in at all, and would be lured away midway by one of the other companions. He didn't have the silver tongue of those companions—he couldn't coax this female guest into a good mood.

One thought after another swirled through his mind in disorder. The crease on the page grew larger and larger. Just as he was turning a page, his room door was pushed open.

"A'Nu."

Shen Shizou heard that woman soften her voice, calling him by the name she had given him at some point, and walk in from the doorway. Her voice was warm and gentle as she said: "Pack a few things. We can go now."

Shen Shizou's whole body trembled. He looked toward the doorway in astonishment.

Gongzi Garden was a place that dazzled the eyes, all gleaming jade and flowing vermillion, red wood and green tiles—but that woman stood there like a clear breeze beneath the forest, and after removing her bamboo hat, gave him a faint smile.

Shen Shizou's hand jerked, and he tore the page right out of the book in his hands.

——

When Shen Shizou was redeemed, the entire Gongzi Garden came out to watch. They all envied Shen Shizou's good fortune, and called out advice to him all at once.

"Being redeemed is the best outcome. Find a good woman to live with. Behave yourself from now on—don't end up back in a place like this."

"Being kept as a kept man isn't bad either. Serve her carefully. With female guests, as long as you have some skill in bed and listen to what she says, you can earn some favor."
